command_plan.description: Verify committed disposable-stack service contract for postgres, redis, api, worker, and frontend.
Apply migrations to the disposable database and prove the migration command succeeds.
Verify live DB revision equals repository Alembic head and critical runtime schema exists.
Ping the configured Redis instance from the current repo environment.
Probe API /ready and require HTTP 200 from the live API.
